risks.title: Credit risk
risks.score_rationale: Credit risk is high due to the company's reliance on lending and the possibility of borrower default. The company uses loss forecasting models to estimate its allowance for credit losses, but these models may be sensitive to changes in economic conditions.

risks.title: Regulatory risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations in the banking and financial sector, and changes in these regulations could negatively impact its operations. The company must also comply with consumer protection laws and data privacy regulations.

risks.title: Liquidity risk
risks.score_rationale: The company must maintain sufficient liquidity to meet client needs and respond to changes in market conditions. A decline in liquidity could negatively affect the company's ability to meet its obligations.

risks.title: Reputation risk
risks.score_rationale: The company's reputation is essential for its long-term success. Damage to the company's reputation could negatively impact its ability to attract and retain customers, as well as its ability to recruit and retain qualified employees.

risks.title: Cybersecurity risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks due to its reliance on information and communication technologies. A data security breach could negatively affect the company's reputation and its ability to protect sensitive customer information.

risks.title: Competitive risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market with numerous banks and financial institutions. Increased competition could negatively impact the company's ability to attract and retain customers, as well as its ability to maintain competitive pricing.

risks.title: Litigation risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to litigation risk due to its involvement in legal activities and the possibility of disputes with customers, employees or third parties. Litigation could negatively affect the company's reputation and financial results.

risks.title: Geopolitical risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to geopolitical risk due to its presence in regional markets and the possibility of changes in political and economic conditions. Changes in geopolitical conditions could negatively impact the company's financial performance.

ai_positioning.summary: CHCO does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. The information provided focuses on financial aspects, retail banking operations and risk management without addressing emerging technologies such as AI.
